title: Genomic determinants of response to alpelisib plus fulvestrant in the SOLAR-1 trial.
authors: Juric, D; Rugo, H S; Reising, A; Vervier, K; Ma, C; Ciruelos, E M; Loibl, S; Singer, C F; Sohn, J; Campone, M; Conte, P; Iwata, H; Ghaznawi, F; Miller, M; Taran, T; Su, F; Andre, F
journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
one_liner_zh: 该研究分析SOLAR-1试验中PIK3CA突变乳腺癌患者对alpelisib联合fulvestrant治疗的基因组决定因素，聚焦临床疗效与基因突变关联，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Approximately 40% of patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative advanced breast cancer (ABC) have PIK3CA alterations, which contributes to endocrine therapy resistance. Alpelisib, an alpha-selective phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase inhibitor and degrader, given in combination with fulvestrant, is approved for the treatment of PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive, HER2-negative ABC, based on the results of the SOLAR-1 trial (NCT02437318). Aside from PIK3CA, other gene alterations are associated with poor prognosis and limited response to treatment in this patient population. PATIENTS AND METHODS: In this retrospective analysis, we carried out tissue-based next-generation sequencing of 398 patients (237 PIK3CA-altered, 161 PIK3CA-wild type) from SOLAR-1. Progression-free survival (PFS) correlative analysis was carried out in the PIK3CA-altered cohort. RESULTS: PIK3CA-altered and PIK3CA-wild type tumors had distinct genomic profiles. In the PIK3CA-altered cohort, patients who received alpelisib plus fulvestrant had a median PFS of 11.01 months versus 5.55 months for those receiving placebo plus fulvestrant (P = 0.0004). Patients in the lowest tumor mutational burden quartile as well as those with FGFR1 or FGFR2 alterations derived greater PFS benefit from alpelisib plus fulvestrant versus placebo plus fulvestrant [18.5 versus 3.22 months: hazard ratio (HR) 0.38, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.21-0.68; FGFR1 12.71 versus 3.75 months: HR 0.38, 95% CI 0.17-0.81, P = 0.32; FGFR2 9.63 versus 2.78 months: HR 0.31, 95% CI 0.1-0.94, P = 0.29]; patients with MYC or RAD21 alterations derived limited PFS benefit. Cox and multitask machine learning models identified lower Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status, prior cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitor (CDK4/6i) treatment, and PTEN or TP53 alterations among the most deleterious factors for PFS in the PIK3CA-altered cohort. CONCLUSIONS: Alpelisib plus fulvestrant provides clinical benefit for patients with PIK3CA-altered, HR-positive, HER2-negative ABC across a range of concomitant alterations, including those previously implicated in endocrine therapy or CDK4/6i resistance. Machine learning models can identify factors including gene mutations that influenced PFS.
abstract_zh: 背景：约40%的激素受体（HR）阳性、人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）阴性晚期乳腺癌（ABC）患者存在PIK3CA突变，这导致内分泌治疗耐药。Alpelisib是一种α选择性磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶抑制剂和降解剂，与fulvestrant联合使用，基于SOLAR-1试验（NCT02437318）的结果，已被批准用于治疗PIK3CA突变、HR阳性、HER2阴性ABC。除PIK3CA外，其他基因突变与该患者群体的不良预后和治疗反应有限相关。患者与方法：在本回顾性分析中，我们对SOLAR-1中的398例患者（237例PIK3CA突变，161例PIK3CA野生型）进行了基于组织的下一代测序。在PIK3CA突变队列中进行了无进展生存期（PFS）相关性分析。结果：PIK3CA突变和PIK3CA野生型肿瘤具有不同的基因组特征。在PIK3CA突变队列中，接受alpelisib联合fulvestrant治疗的患者中位PFS为11.01个月，而接受安慰剂联合fulvestrant治疗的患者为5.55个月（P = 0.0004）。肿瘤突变负荷最低四分位数的患者以及携带FGFR1或FGFR2突变的患者，从alpelisib联合fulvestrant中获得的PFS获益大于安慰剂联合fulvestrant [18.5对3.22个月：风险比（HR）0.38，95%置信区间（CI）0.21-0.68；FGFR1 12.71对3.75个月：HR 0.38，95% CI 0.17-0.81，P = 0.32；FGFR2 9.63对2.78个月：HR 0.31，95% CI 0.1-0.94，P = 0.29]；携带MYC或RAD21突变的患者PFS获益有限。Cox和多任务机器学习模型识别出较低的东部肿瘤协作组体能状态、既往细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4/6抑制剂（CDK4/6i）治疗以及PTEN或TP53突变是PIK3CA突变队列中PFS最不利的因素。结论：Alpelisib联合fulvestrant为携带多种伴随突变的PIK3CA突变、HR阳性、HER2阴性ABC患者提供临床获益，包括那些先前被认为与内分泌治疗或CDK4/6i耐药相关的突变。机器学习模型可以识别包括基因突变在内的影响PFS的因素。
